steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya, at this rate, Mr. Thomas is going to get captured by Dublinn again!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Are you planning to...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That bloody bugger!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I'll bring him back.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Why are you stopping me? Didn't we go through all the trouble to rescue that bloke?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The situation's changed. We can't blow Siege's cover.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: So you're just gonna let him go? That's not how the Glasgow Gang does things!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't make a ruckus here, either of you.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Listen to Amiya and the Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sniper operators, on the enemies holding our mark.

options: The important thing is that caster.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Caster......

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If I recall correctly, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: According to Misery's intel and Bagpipe's report, she's the leader of Dublinn's forces inside Londinium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And one of the instigators of the County Hillock incident.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island doesn't put the blame for Outcast's sacrifice entirely on her shoulders, but it's not just Misery and Bagpipe who hold a grudge against her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Bagpipe tells us she's very hard to deal with.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We could get into a fight with Dublinn here, rescue Mr. Thomas, and even eliminate Mandragora, a formidable enemy who may pose a significant threat to our future operations.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The Sarkaz are coming!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're too late.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All squads, continue to conceal yourselves––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Be ready to engage.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's going on over here? So noisy.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Oh, if it isn't you traitorous lot.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Don't you dare use that word.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: We have nothing to do with Victoria now, devil.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hmph... Who said you could call us that?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Hah... A motley band of exiles, taking advantage of the chaos to occupy a city. What made you delusional enough to think yourselves the masters of Londinium?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Haha, don't lump me in with your sorry band, thinking we actually give a damn about Londinium.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The place is shiny and clean, isn't it? Doesn't reek of death. But if you ask me, it'll be more pleasing to the eye once it's burnt to cinders.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The Sarkaz are only here because our King is here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Their King? The Sarkaz King?

options: The regent finally decided to crown himself?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I haven't heard anything about that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But a lot of intel reports disparate Sarkaz fighters gathering in Londinium from across Terra, and it's not just the mercenaries we're familiar with.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are... older, stronger powers now hovering around the heart of this city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I can feel it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Since coming here, with each step closer I take, those emotions flow into the depths of my heart... tangle around my thoughts, and grow stronger and stronger.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm fine, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just that... for a split second, it's as if...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When I heard those Sarkaz mention their 'King,' a wisp of those emotions... sprung up and latched onto me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't think I can give a better description of what I felt...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'd love to spend some time talking this through with you... but not now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if there were... a Sarkaz King who now controls Londinium, that doesn't change our mission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We came here to prevent a war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need to figure out exactly what they're doing, and what they're trying to do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ––And that has nothing to do with what Theresis decides to call himself.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: So, can we skip past the shitty pleasantries, Dublinn?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Turn over the man you captured.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Why should I?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We'll take good care of your old home.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You bastard––!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain...!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Not just you. You too, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I know who you are, Feline. You're their commander.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But why should I listen to you?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Because I've been to the Palace of Westhaleg.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Haha, we've all heard the story. You wanted an audience with His Majesty, but he had you escorted out.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Do you really think you mean anything to the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, why do we just sit here and let the devils mock us?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I can't take it anymore. Ever since we came to Londinium, we've had to live with this inferior race—

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Not one more word.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: We can go back and bring this up with the Leader...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I said, not one more word!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Sarkaz, no matter how hard you try to provoke me, I'm not leaving.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: We are your guests, as the one you call 'His Majesty' and his privy council agreed.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Do you really want to find out how the Sarkaz deal with rowdy 'guests?'

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Well, at least one of us understands proper etiquette.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: We promised your regent and your generals that Dublinn's troops would not set foot into Central Londinium.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Likewise, you should not be detaining me here, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Or, do you devils struggle to keep your word? Can you even spell 'trustworthy?'

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hah, you uppity Feline... Isn't the fact that I haven't chopped you into pieces right here and now already proof that I'm honoring our little pretend friendship?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If a Sarkaz ever forgot his objective and started picking fights, he'd be found dead in a bar near a warzone pretty quick.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We're here to root out some bottom feeders. These nobodies haven't learned their place yet. They're sneaking around, making a mess of our work––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: By the sound of things, they're not looking for Mr. Thomas either.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could that be the friends the Messenger mentioned, the ones who can help us with our operation?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Sarkaz certainly would call them an enemy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If they really are right here, maybe we could help them...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The line stopped moving.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I hear fighting... the Sarkaz must've gotten into a row with someone.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, I saw their uniforms... it's Dublinn!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Her.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: The Dublinn caster?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: She... She's a scary one...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: She's killed some of our people. She impales them on stone pillars that come out of nowhere. Her methods are even more brutal than the Sarkaz!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, have you fought her too? What am I even saying? You've saved so many from Dublinn, you must've beaten her...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I lost.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: But you... still managed to get away from her with your life. That's already amazing enough.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm still not exactly sure why she didn't kill me on the spot... but I have my guesses.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: At the Barracks outside Londinium, I saw them having secret meetings with a count's Messenger.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I figured she must've shown me deliberately.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Or maybe it wasn't her. Someone like her would have no way of knowing that my grandfather and the count's father served together. They were very close.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And the count himself... If I recall correctly, was squire to a duke.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sorry, I shouldn't be saying all this.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: During the long period of time I was hiding in the dark bowels of this city, I... got used to talking to the metal crabs. They didn't have much to say back.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I didn't have to worry about my words casting a shadow over anyone else.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Some things, I just had to say to myself so I wouldn't forget them.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: I didn't mean to interrupt you, Lieutenant!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: I'd actually like to hear more. For the longest time, I've been wanting to know who's pulling the strings up there, causing us all this misery!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The duke I was thinking of isn't even in Londinium right now. Or rather, I should say... he never cared a lick about the vacant throne in the city.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If he really were secretly supporting Dublinn, that would answer a lot of questions. But at the same time, it would also greatly complicate the crisis we have on our hands...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Listen to me. Everything I've said to you up to this point is just baseless speculation. If you want to hear more, we'll continue another time.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Provided... you're willing to follow me into the shadows.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: What are we going to do now?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Right now... we need to find an opportunity to escape.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Dublinn has been trying to get something from the Sarkaz. It might be one individual or several, which is why they've set up in Sudean.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: In addition to troops like you, hunted by the Sarkaz, they've captured a good lot of civilians with some connection to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Whatever Mandragora is trying to accomplish...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: As long as it creates conflict between Dublinn and the Sarkaz, it'll work in our favor.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Sounds like you have a plan.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben, did you make sure to hide the crossbow I gave you? Up your sleeves, right?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Of course, Lieutenant!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Aim at that Dublinn soldier, the one closest to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It looks like Dublinn isn't backing down.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Sarkaz have a limit to their patience. This is going to boil over into a fight, sooner or later.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we're going to have to use our backup plan.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: C'mon, turn him over and you all get to walk out of here alive. Let's make things easy for each other, why don't we?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: ...Captain, shouldn't we...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I don't understand...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: No means no.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Even if it fractures our relationship with the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You heard what they had to say.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: When... have we ever been friends?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: There you go. Those are your words, not mine.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ––Formation! Round up these Dublinn wretches!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: He is absolutely critical to Dublinn. Non-negotiable.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: If we can't bring him with us, our only option is to kill him here.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Waaaah!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Shut your trap.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Actually, our other option... is to kill all these Sarkaz.
Isn't it about time we make our entrance?
Hold on, we're still calibrating the aerial coordinates.
Look, if we don't act now, someone's gonna get killed.
Give me a sec... Seventeen meters in a straight line... Sixteen... Fifteen...
Best to get a bit closer or you might have trouble aiming, right?
No can do. They'll spot us if I get any closer!
Just do as I say. It won't miss, trust me, or I'll let you use my head as a rivet— Move it a little eastward and the reflection of light should cover its wings...
Now!
Rock-5, you're up!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's our cue.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben, now!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hey, hey, hey–– Gah!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's the meaning of this?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: The hell are you talking about? You're the ones who tried to snipe us––

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Fight back!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Those who spill Sarkaz blood will pay the blood debt with interest!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't let a single one out of here alive!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Remember, you started this.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: ––With me. Slaughter every last Sarkaz.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Don't let a single one live to tell the tale.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: The devil leadership mustn't learn what happened here today.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Aaaaaaaahhhh––!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Save me! Someone, anyone!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya, these civilians have nowhere to run... It's not just Mr. Thomas, so many are going to get caught in the crossfire!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Neither the Sarkaz nor Dublinn have any regard for civilian lives!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doctor, Amiya, I'm sorry, but I can't just stand by and let this happen.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I just can't.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All operators, there's been a change in plans!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All non-combat personnel are to remain hidden. All combat personnel, save as many lives as you can. But mind your own safety!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Another bolt from behind?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It came from those ones, in civilian clothes... They're carrying unauthorized weapons!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Something's not right. We've got more hostiles in the elevator!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hah... Looks like we've grabbed the pest's tail.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Turns out the rebels ARE here––

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Report this to General Manfred right away!
